title: Finish backend consolidation, remove legacy duplicates and eliminate runtime mocks
description: Complete the unfinished P1-P6 structural cutover from commit e67f402. Migrate all unique tests and active tooling to Backend/ZhongWenHub and Backend/ZhongWenHub.Tests, prove runtime/migration/API parity, remove the production MockAIProvider, then delete Backend/src and Backend/tests.
acceptance_criteria: Backend/ZhongWenHub.sln contains exactly ZhongWenHub and ZhongWenHub.Tests
Exactly two csproj files exist under Backend
Backend/src and Backend/tests no longer exist
All six missing unit/SQL test files and all legacy integration tests are adapted into ZhongWenHub.Tests before deletion
The final test count represents unique tests in one project and does not sum duplicated suites
CI restores, builds and tests only the consolidated projects
Active developer docs, scripts and runtime messages contain no dependency on old backend paths
Production DI and code contain no MockAIProvider and no fake-success AI fallback
Runtime OpenAPI operations, role behavior and public JSON contracts have no unintended regression
The full forward-only SQL Server migration chain is owned by the new project
docker-compose uses SQL Server for an isolated local/test database instead of PostgreSQL
Backend build/tests and frontend lint/tests/build pass
ZhongWenHub_Dev remains unchanged under zero-write policy
safety_constraints: Do not delete legacy directories until tests, solution, CI and active path references are migrated
Never write to ZhongWenHub_Dev or any production database
Never rewrite an applied EF migration
Never commit secrets, API keys or real database credentials
Do not force-push or merge directly to main
Do not introduce microservices, MediatR, CQRS, generic repositories or enterprise infrastructure
Do not perform a cosmetic repository-wide namespace rewrite
Do not modify historical result documents solely to hide legacy-path references
Do not claim blocked or skipped integration tests as passed
